inputs.share_count_basis: Fully diluted. 1,060,126,218 shares in issue at 31 May 2026 (FY2026 AR note 26) less 7,418,000 repurchased in May 2026 and held as treasury at balance date, cancelled 14 July 2026 = 1,052,708,218; plus 20,501,932 dilutive potential shares (FY2026 diluted weighted average 1,071,759,046 less basic 1,051,257,114, note 11) = 1,073.21m. Held FLAT: SBC is fully expensed in the flows, so charging dilution as well would double-count. Option exercises (8.5m FY2026, 12.8m FY2025) are the vesting of that already-expensed SBC.
inputs.cash_composition: Cash and cash equivalents 1,701.4 + term deposits current 1,354.5 + term deposits non-current 182.8 + wealth management products at FVTPL current 2,273.8 + non-current 301.0 = 5,813.5 (RMB m, 31 May 2026 statement of financial position; company's own 'total monetary capital' RMB5.8bn, MD&A liquidity paragraph). Restricted bank deposits of 126.6 (consumer funds in a special account) are operating and excluded. 11.6 of other non-current FVTPL (not wealth management products) is excluded. Lease liabilities (22.0 current + 10.4 non-current) are excluded because leases are charged as an operating cost in the flows (treatment B). No bank borrowings since FY2022.
inputs.sbc_source: FY2026 AR consolidated cash flow statement, 'Share-based compensation expenses' RMB81,081k (file line 7441). No separate equity-award tax withholding line is disclosed (EquityAwardTaxes 0 in every period); awards settle by share issuance, so the add-back is the full cost.
inputs.interest_income_note: Only the RMB13.4m of bank-balance interest is received inside operating cash flow (line 7468) and therefore inside reported FCF; the RMB63.5m term-deposit interest and RMB55.6m FVTPL fair-value gains are stripped by the accrual adjustments and received in investing. P&L interest income is 77.3m. None of the income on the 5,813.5 monetary pile is in the forward EBITDA path (operating profit 663.4 excludes 'other income, gains and losses'), and the whole pile is in the bridge: matching-asset rule satisfied.
inputs.buyback_note: RMB167.4m paid in FY2026 for 7.418m shares (HK$186.75m) under the up-to-RMB500m programme authorised after the Dong Yuhui departure; RMB110.4m in FY2025. The company is a repurchaser, so the flat count is being funded, although FY2026 buybacks (7.4m shares) were below option exercises plus vesting (14.0m).
inputs.fx_note: CNY -> HKD 1.1726, Yahoo Finance CNYHKD=X regular quote 2026-10-16; cross-checked against the USDHKD/USDCNY legs at build time (see build output). All flows and per-share values are computed in CNY and converted at this rate; unsuffixed intrinsic_value / weighted_iv are in HKD to match current_price, the _cny twins carry the model currency. East Buy has no dual listing, so no parity check against a second quote is possible. The rate is dated and must be refreshed with the price: refresh_price.py does not move fx_rate.
inputs.price_as_of: 2026-10-16T08:08:14Z HKEX regular close (Yahoo Finance chart API); 52-week range 17.59-33.00
inputs.wacc_rationale: WACC built in CNY, the flows' own currency: 10-year China government bond ~1.8%, China equity risk premium incl. country risk ~7%, beta ~1.15 for a volatile HK-listed China consumer-internet mid-cap -> cost of equity ~9.9%; no debt, so WACC = cost of equity = 10.0%. No ad-hoc premium for key-person or Douyin-platform risk: those are charged once, in the bear scenario path and its 30% weight, and the same 10% is used in all three scenarios.
inputs.lease_treatment: (B) Leases as operating cost. FY2026 lease principal RMB35.1m (financing, line 7508) + lease interest RMB1.5m (finance costs, line 7194) = RMB36.6m = 0.64% of revenue, charged inside adjusted EBITDA via lease_cost_pct_path. Lease liabilities (RMB32.5m) are therefore excluded from net debt, and D&A for the cash-tax EBIT is ex right-of-use depreciation: 15.9m of PPE depreciation only (0.28% of revenue), not the 48.7m total.
inputs.nci_treatment: Flows are consolidated; the RMB1.2m non-controlling interest (FY2026 NCI profit share RMB0.3m, 0.06% of profit) is deducted once in the equity bridge at book. Associates (RMB50.0m at book) are added once in the bridge because their share of results is outside operating profit.
inputs.tax_note: FY2026 cash tax paid RMB148.4m = 22.5% of component EBIT (~660); income tax expense 140.5 = 20.5% of PBT. The main operating subsidiary's HNTE 15% preferential rate covered calendar 2023-2025 and renewal is not confirmed; statutory PRC rate is 25%, and 5-10% withholding applies on any dividend repatriation to the Cayman parent. Cash tax ramps 22% -> 25% by year 4 and stays there.
inputs.notes: Model: owner-FCF component DCF (SKILL.md routing row 'operating company, non-US' with the adaptations file: CNY flows vs HKD quote, material leases, net-cash matching-asset rule, SBC present so house/street band is live). First valuation of this ticker; no memory entry. Business is a private-label FMCG brand sold through livestreaming e-commerce (Douyin-dominant) plus own APP and nascent offline stores, spun out of New Oriental; the education (Koolearn) business was disposed in FY2024 so FY2018-FY2023 history is a different business and the historical CAGRs are reported but NOT used as growth inputs. FY2024 is mixed-basis (continuing revenue 6,525.6; total net income 1,719.5 includes a ~RMB1.47bn disposal gain; continuing net income 249.1). FY0 component tie-out: operating profit 663.4 + SBC 81.1 + total D&A 48.7 = IFRS-16 EBITDA 793.2 (13.9% of revenue), matching the company's adjusted EBITDA 792.6; less lease cash 36.6, less SBC 81.1, less ex-ROU D&A 15.9 = EBIT ~660; cash tax 148.4; capex 6.8; working capital released 138.8 on +1,309 revenue (10.6% capture). Component owner FCF FY2026 ~662 vs last_fcf 700.9 (which does not yet carry the lease charge). Horizon 10 years because growth is decelerating from +24% and the margin is still ramping. Terminal cap 15x (not the 20x default) for a platform-dependent, key-person-exposed China consumer name; at WACC 10% / g 2.5% Gordon is 13.7x so Gordon binds in base and bear.

equity_bridge.note: FY2026 AR note 15; share of results is outside operating profit so the asset is added once (matching-asset rule)
FY2026 AR statement of financial position; flows are consolidated so NCI is deducted once here

historical_growth.growth_rate_source: Base-case FY2027-FY2029 average revenue growth (24/14/10), anchored on the H2 FY2026 run-rate (+53.7% YoY) lapping a weak H1 FY2026. Not a historical CAGR: every pre-FY2024 figure includes the disposed Koolearn education business.
historical_growth.growth_divergence_warning: Equity 3yr CAGR 26.0% (inflated by the ~RMB1.47bn FY2024 education disposal gain) diverges by more than 30pp from owner-FCF 3yr CAGR -17.0% and EPS 3yr CAGR -17.5%; neither direction is representative because FY2023 was the Dong Yuhui peak (adj EBITDA margin 26.8%) and FY2025 the post-departure trough. 5-year EPS and FCF CAGRs are undefined (negative FY2021 base).
historical_growth.notes: Owner FCF history = reported FCF - SBC - P&L interest income (FY2026 shown on that consistent basis, 637.0; the inputs.last_fcf of 700.9 uses only the 13.4 of interest actually inside OCF). Owner-FCF CAGR (-17.0%) is below reported-FCF CAGR (-14.0%) over FY2023-26 mainly because of the FY2024 SBC spike (RMB417.9m, 6.4% of revenue) rather than rising SBC today: SBC fell to 1.4% of revenue in FY2026. Revenue FY2021-FY2023 is dominated by the pivot from online education to livestreaming e-commerce, so the 5yr revenue CAGR of 32.1% measures a business-model change, not organic growth.

base.growth_rationale: FY2027 +24%: H2 FY2026 revenue 3,389 was +53.7% YoY and H1 FY2027 laps a weak H1 FY2026 (2,312); roughly H1 ~3,200 / H2 ~3,850 gives ~7,050. Private-label GMV grew 37% in FY2026 while third-party resale declines, so blended growth fades to 14%, 10%, 8% as the mix shift completes, then to 3% nominal (China CPI ~1-2% plus modest real growth).
base.margin_rationale: FY2026 IFRS-16 EBITDA margin 13.9% (H2 operating margin 11.8% vs H1 11.4%). Year-1 dips to 13.5% for the livestreaming-matrix, offline-store and instant-retail investment CMB International flags, then private-label mix (gross margin 35.8%, up from 32.0%) lifts it to a 14.5% mature level. That is well below the FY2023 26.8% Dong-Yuhui-era peak, which is not treated as repeatable.
base.capex_wc_rationale: Capex 0.5% of revenue (FY2024 0.55%, FY2025 0.59%, FY2026 0.12%) funds experience stores, vending machines and front warehouses; ex-ROU D&A converges on it. Working capital: payables-funded negative-WC model (trade payables 698 vs inventories 484 + receivables 264 + prepayments 103), FY2026 captured 10.6% of the revenue increase; 5% is used because the private-label inventory build (inventories +57%) absorbs part of that.

bull.rationale: H2 FY2026 run-rate (annualised ~6,780) persists and compounds: FY2027 +36%, private-label passes 65% of GMV, omni-channel (APP membership, stores on the New Oriental campus network, instant retail) adds a second leg, EBITDA margin reaches 17.5% (still 9pp below the FY2023 peak). Higher capex (0.7%) for the store roll-out; working capital capture 8%, nearer the FY2026 actual.

bear.rationale: A second traffic shock in the FY2025 pattern, smaller: further host departures (two more left in April 2026) or a Douyin algorithm/fee change cut FY2027 growth to +8% and FY2028 to -5%; margin falls to 8% (FY2025 was 2.3%) as retention grants lift SBC to 1.8% and selling spend is held to defend GMV, then recovers only to a 10% mature level as a commoditised private-label seller without a star host. Terminal growth 2%.

scenario_narratives.base: The product-driven pivot holds: private-label share of GMV keeps rising from 52.6%, the H2 FY2026 acceleration carries into FY2027 (+24%) and fades to mid-single digits by FY2032 as third-party resale shrinks and Douyin remains the dominant channel. Margins recover modestly to 14.5% EBITDA, not to the Dong Yuhui-era 27%. Cash tax normalises to 25% as HNTE relief lapses. The RMB5.8bn monetary pile is carried at face in the bridge and earns nothing in the flows.
scenario_narratives.bull: East Buy becomes a durable private-label FMCG brand rather than a livestreaming channel: SPU count keeps compounding, APP membership and offline/instant retail reduce Douyin dependence, gross margin keeps widening with mix, and EBITDA margin reaches 17.5% on revenue that roughly 3.6x's over the decade. Buybacks continue to fund the flat count.
scenario_narratives.bear: The key-person and platform fragility demonstrated in FY2025 recurs: another host or executive exit, a scripting-style reputational event, or a Douyin policy change drives a second GMV decline in FY2028, margins compress to 8% and recover only to 10%, and the company settles into low-single-digit growth as one of many private-label sellers on someone else's platform. The business survives on its cash pile but the growth premium in the current price does not.

probability_weighted.weights_rationale: Bear raised to 30% from the 15% house default because the thesis rests on an unproven pivot (product-driven after the business lost ~40% of GMV to one host's departure), a single-platform dependency on Douyin, and continuing turnover (CEO Sun Dongxu left Nov 2025, two more hosts Apr 2026). Bull cut to 20% because it needs three independent things to go right at once: continued private-label mix gains, successful omni-channel execution in a capital-intensive new format, and no further host or platform shock. Base 50%.

valuation_philosophy.summary: Owner-FCF DCF, SBC fully expensed with a flat fully diluted count, leases charged as an operating cost, cash tax ramped to the 25% statutory rate, and the RMB5.8bn of cash, term deposits and wealth-management products added once in the bridge with none of their income in the flows. Risk is charged once, in the scenario paths and a 30/50/20 weighting, not in a scenario-specific WACC. The terminal multiple is capped at 15x because the business is platform-dependent and has shown single-host fragility. Value is reported in HKD to match the quote, computed in CNY.
key_risks_to_valuation: Key-person dependence: the FY2025 GMV collapse followed one livestreamer's departure; founder Yu Minhong still hosts, and executive/host turnover continued through 2026
Douyin platform concentration: algorithm, fee or policy changes are outside the company's control and the owned APP is a minority of GMV
Margin durability: FY2026's 13.9% EBITDA margin is one year of recovery; the FY2023 27% peak was a traffic phenomenon and FY2025 was 2.3%
Cash tax: HNTE 15% relief for the main subsidiary covered calendar 2023-2025 and renewal is unconfirmed; 5-10% withholding on repatriation
Cash pile valuation: RMB2.6bn of wealth-management products carry non-guaranteed principal and returns; they are taken at book
FX: CNY flows against an HKD quote; the bridge rate is dated 2026-10-16 and is not refreshed by price-only updates
